skill: Translate a linear combination of three R^3 vectors into three scalar equations, solve by Gaussian elimination/back substitution or identify inconsistency, then evaluate the requested signed sum of coefficients.
reasoning_steps: Interpret each displayed vector as a column of A in Ax=b.
Equate corresponding components and form the augmented matrix.
Use elementary row operations, including exchanges as needed, to find coefficients or a contradiction.
Evaluate the specified x1+x2+x3 or x1+x2-x3 and choose its value from the complete five-choice radio bank.
response_contract: Observed questions use one radio field named selection and five choices: four numbers plus No solution, except q-105168 which has five numbers. Canonical worked example has no captured answer field.
difficulty: Moderate source questions are nonsingular integer systems; hard source questions are inconsistent singular systems. Requested moderate therefore supports unique coefficient solutions; hard must remain supported for source replay but need not be mixed into moderate delivery.
invariants: Three coefficient unknowns multiplying three displayed vectors in R^3; supplied right-hand vector.
Component equality and standard Gaussian elimination remain the method and workload.
One scalar target built from coefficient sums/differences, or No solution if inconsistent.
Complete radio banks and worked explanations must agree with the vectors and target.
permitted_variations: Vary small integer vector components and compatible right-hand vectors while controlling elimination workload.
Vary solved coefficients, signs and zero values; their particular answers are incidental.
Change which coefficient is subtracted, or retain the all-plus target, deriving the answer and solution accordingly; q-74028 explicitly establishes a signed target.
Vary pivot rows/exchanges and placement of easy component equations without increasing system size.
Vary complete source bank profiles, distractor numbers and correct option position; presence of No solution must not disclose the outcome.
Hard inconsistency can use different row dependencies and contradictory right-hand entries. Consistent underdetermined systems requiring an undetermined sum are not evidenced by this KP.

answer_roles.essential: Determined by consistency and the specified target, not bank layout.
Signed scalar target is supported; a particular minus position is incidental.
